title: Midpoint Explorer
prompt: Move the endpoints and watch the midpoint stay exactly halfway in both the x- and y-directions.

fallback.markdown:
The midpoint is found by averaging the x-coordinates and averaging the y-coordinates:

$$M = \left(\frac{x_1 + x_2}{2}, \frac{y_1 + y_2}{2}\right)$$

If one endpoint moves, recompute both averages and the midpoint moves with it.
